description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #

---

## 📝 Summary
Syncs the plugin bindings API documentation with the current schema implementation. The previous doc was out of date — `OUTPUT_LENGTH_GUARD` was missing 9 fields, `RATE_LIMITER` had the wrong type for `by_tool` and was missing 5 backend/algorithm fields, a broken code fence was swallowing the DELETE by UUID section, and `binding_reference_id` format constraints were undocumented.

Changes:
- **`OUTPUT_LENGTH_GUARD`**: Added `min_tokens`, `max_tokens`, `chars_per_token`, `limit_mode`, `word_boundary`, `max_text_length`, `max_structure_size`, `max_recursion_depth`; fixed `max_chars` default (`null`, not `2000`) and type (`Optional[int]`)
- **`RATE_LIMITER`**: Fixed `by_tool` type (`Dict[str, str]` not a flat rate string); added `algorithm`, `backend`, `redis_url`, `redis_key_prefix`, `redis_fallback`
- **DELETE section**: Fixed broken code fence that was rendering the "Delete by UUID" prose and curl example as code
- **`binding_reference_id`**: Documented `max_length=255` and pattern constraint in the request field table
- Updated all inline `curl` examples and the multi-plugin example to include complete field sets (required by the `PluginPolicyItem` validator)

---

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature / Enhancement
- [x] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

---

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                     | Command         | Status |
|---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| Lint suite                | `make lint`     | N/A — docs only |
| Unit tests                | `make test`     | N/A — docs only |
| Coverage ≥ 80%            | `make coverage` | N/A — docs only |

---

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes
- [x] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [x] No secrets or credentials committed

---

## 📓 Notes (optional)
All examples now pass the `PluginPolicyItem` cross-validator which requires every config field to be present — partial configs in the doc would have caused copy-paste failures for users.
